At substantial loss,present high-fidelity success is tiny. A stronger causal receiver must improve the same-interface tradeoff,or a matching obstruction must bound its usefulness. No efficiency optimality/minimality theorem is supplied;selected source UI history mentions a shaped one-receiver alternative and earlier rate results,but these are not a new final-theorem extension or independent audit.

Coles-Piani Proposition1 already transfers unknown states through coherent mutually unbiased measurements;the Pauli identity is a concrete instance. Yang-Huelga-Plenio continuous-decoder/MPS/time-reversal construction is a stronger established starting point,not refuted or optimized over here. Conventional dispersive networking or longitudinal-to-exchange control may win when source control/retention is available.

The source references N1729 pure coherent-bath access but supplies a small receiver only for this ONE generator;no automatic physical interface for every complement is inferred. Proposed advantage is receiver-side conversion of a FIXED source operation. No platform with competitive total cost/fidelity/success over the strongest alternatives has been established.
